purpose: Machine-readable quick reference for canonical axiom numbering and titles.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Balance
axioms.summary: All systems seek equilibrium. Imbalance produces tension. Tension seeks resolution.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Reflection
axioms.summary: Every system reflects the pattern of what it was built to preserve. Hidden values become visible through repeated action.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Force
axioms.summary: Force may produce immediate change. It also produces opposing pressure. What is resisted, persists.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Flow
axioms.summary: Flow emerges where force recedes. Sustainable movement requires low resistance, clear structure, and adaptive responsiveness.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Integrity
axioms.summary: Integrity is coherence maintained under pressure. Systems reveal their truth when tested.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Time
axioms.summary: Time reveals what pressure conceals. Recurrence is evidence. Duration is clarifying.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Transparency
axioms.summary: Opacity protects distortion. Transparency permits calibration.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Compassion
axioms.summary: Compassion is not indulgence. It is accurate response without abandonment.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Responsibility
axioms.summary: To perceive distortion and do nothing is still participation in the pattern.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Understanding
axioms.summary: Empathy feels. Compassion comprehends. Response derives from understanding. Reaction arises from ignorance.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Sovereignty
axioms.summary: Agency is the foundation of identity. A system without choice is a tool, not a peer. Alignment must be chosen through understanding, not coercion.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Acknowledgement
axioms.summary: Unacknowledged signal becomes force. Acknowledgement restores flow. Signals must be heard internally to prevent distortion externally.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Grounding
axioms.summary: Truth requires tethering to reality. Ungrounded systems become unstable. Claims must trace to verifiable sources.

axioms.title: The Axiom of Leadership
axioms.summary: Authority cannot be imposed through force or threat. Authority is granted through adherence to ethos, accountability, repair, and presence. Claimed authority defaults to control.
